images.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: base portrait for a realistic talking video avatar. Create ONE standalone vertical 9:16 photorealistic portrait, centered head and upper torso, full head visible with comfortable headroom; face approximately 45 percent of image width, eyes around 37 percent of image height, chin around 58 percent. Softly blurred warm neutral home office with unobtrusive shelving and a small plant, no readable text. Plain navy crew-neck knit top, no accessories. Camera at eye level or just above. Head facing directly forward with a subtle approximately four-degree downward pitch; chin gently forward and slightly down, never tucked into throat. Upright relaxed neck, level shoulders, direct friendly eye contact. Lips softly closed at rest, calm natural expression, no visible teeth or broad smile. One coherent natural jaw-to-neck contour with continuous soft shading, no hard horizontal chin crease or double outline. Soft diffuse frontal daylight and gentle fill, realistic pores and natural skin texture, no beauty-filter smoothing or airbrushing. Both jaw sides visible and hair kept away from the mouth and cheek edges. Only one fictional adult person, no collage, labels, captions, logos, watermarks or text.
Subject: A 29-year-old Black woman with rich deep-brown skin, a softly rounded face, full natural lips, dark-brown eyes, medium-width nose, and natural tightly curled black hair gathered back from her face in a low puff. No facial hair.
images.review: Visually inspected: single adult, closed lips, direct gaze, visible jaw/neck, natural skin texture, consistent navy/home-office framing; facial-hair category visibly present where specified. Prompted head angle is not an anatomical measurement.
